title: Same-scene speech jump needs a cover
text: A jump to another speech inside the same scene needs a cover: insert, B-roll or a still person (`Backup`) over the join; never two takes of the same shot butted together in plain view (rule 5).

source.heading: Story first, then the speech (user, on YT agent v1, 2026-11-25)

confirm: List each jump to another speech in the same scene and the cover over it.
probe: **A jump to another speech inside the same scene needs a cover.**
